places.connection: Used for the 'out-of-town tryout' scenes where Eve successfully manipulates her way into becoming Margo's understudy.

places.name: 21 Club
places.connection: The setting for scenes where the characters socialize, including a key confrontation. The location was a famous celebrity haunt.

places.name: Curran Theatre
places.connection: Filming location for the opening Sarah Siddons Award ceremony scenes.

places.name: John Golden Theatre
places.connection: The exterior of this Broadway theatre was used as the fictional theater where Margo Channing stars in 'Aged in Wood'.

places.name: Shubert Theatre
places.connection: The location for the out-of-town tryout of Margo's new play, where Eve ultimately replaces her.

places.name: 21 Club
places.connection: A famous former speakeasy and restaurant where scenes with the main characters were filmed. It is now closed.

places.name: 20th Century Fox Studios (Stage 16)
places.connection: The majority of the film's interior scenes, including Margo's apartment and dressing room, were shot on soundstages here.

places.name: The Stork Club
places.connection: Mentioned by Addison DeWitt, this was a legendary nightclub of the era, frequented by celebrities and central to the world the film depicts, though not a filming location.

places.name: Margo Channing's Apartment (Exterior)
places.connection: The exterior of this building was reportedly used for Margo's apartment, though this is debated among location scouts.
